youtube.title: Darwin almost missed evolution because of his NOSE 👃 #shorts
youtube.caption:
The captain of the Beagle almost rejected Charles Darwin... because he didn't like the shape of his nose. 👃⛵

Imagine losing the theory of evolution to a nose review.

Would you have let him on the ship? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on Darwin's own autobiography: Captain FitzRoy doubted him because of his nose before the 1831 Beagle voyage.

#history #historymemes #charlesdarwin #evolution #science #hmsbeagle #shorts
